title: GGSS: Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering for Inference-Time Debiasing of Generative Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.25375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in human-centered settings, yet they can produce demographically biased outputs even when images differ only in controlled attributes such as perceived race or gender. However, existing inference-time debiasers were largely designed for static embeddings or CLIP-like models rather than generative VLMs. We propose GGSS---Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering---a norm-preserving intervention that discovers a counterfactual bias subspace on the unit hypersphere, steers visual tokens along geodesic arcs, and uses an adaptive gate to focus correction on tokens that carry stronger demographic signal. We evaluate four generative VLMs against ten adapted inference-time debiasing baselines and prompt-based mitigation under a single operating-point protocol across categorical, pairwise, and occupation-gender bias tests, while also measuring general visual-language capability. translated_title: GGSS：基于测地线门控球面转向的生成式视觉-语言模型推理时去偏方法
translated_abstract: 生成式视觉-语言模型（VLMs）越来越多地用于以人为中心的应用场景，但即使图像仅在感知种族或性别等受控属性上有所不同，它们也可能产生人口统计偏差的输出。然而，现有的推理时去偏方法主要针对静态嵌入或类似CLIP的模型设计，而非生成式VLMs。我们提出了GGSS——测地线门控球面转向——一种保持范数的干预方法，它在单位超球面上发现反事实偏差子空间，沿测地线弧引导视觉标记，并使用自适应门控聚焦于携带更强人口统计信号的标记进行修正。我们在单一操作点协议下，对四个生成式VLMs与十个改编的推理时去偏基线及基于提示的缓解方法进行了评估，覆盖类别、配对和职业-性别偏差测试，同时测量通用视觉-语言能力。GGSS取得了显著效果。
tldr: 提出了一种名为GGSS的推理时去偏方法，通过测地线门控球面转向在生成式视觉-语言模型中有效消除人口统计偏差，同时保持模型通用能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes GGSS, an inference-time debiasing method using geodesic-gated spherical steering to effectively remove demographic bias in generative vision-language models while preserving general capability.
